name: Beef Vindaloo (Chuck Braise)
why: Verified from source nutrition: 550 cal / 46 g protein / 8 g carbs per serving - dead center of the 400-650 cal band and well under the 35 g carb ceiling. Chuck braise (2 lb chuck simmered with spice sauce), structurally low-carb: meat + onion + spice + vinegar + stock, no rice/potato/bean base, so our computed macros should track. Scales cleanly to 14 (weigh-and-divide from one braise pot). Fills a real catalog gap: many beef curries exist but no vindaloo. Carries 4 genuinely-absent spice flags (garam masala, ground mustard, cayenne, ground ginger) - useful pricer-lane exercise fodder.
confidence: high - nutrition read directly from the recipe card
